title: Gentisic acid attenuates ovalbumin-induced airway inflammation, oxidative stress, and ferroptosis through the modulation of Nrf2/HO-1 and NF-kappaB signaling pathways.
authors: Abdelmawgood, Islam Ahmed; Kotb, Mohamed A; Hassan, Hassan Samy; Mahana, Noha A; Rochdi, Ahmed M; Sayed, Nader Hassan; Elsafoury, Reem H; Saber, Amal M; Youssef, Mahmoud Nabil; Waheeb, Nancy George; Al-Rifai, Mohamed W A; Badr, Abeer Mahmoud; Abdelkader, Asmaa Elsayed
one_liner_zh: 该文研究龙胆酸通过Nrf2/HO-1和NF-kappaB通路缓解哮喘，仅含Keap1蛋白-小分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Asthma, a lung disorder that causes impaired respiratory function, is characterized by an apparent infiltration of inflammatory cells. Gentisic acid (GA), a phenolic acid common in food ingredients, has antioxidant, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. Its potential application in mitigating asthma, however, remains unexplored. The current investigation studies GA's therapeutic potential for allergic asthma. BALB/c mice were challenged and sensitized to ovalbumin (OVA) to establish the animal model. We investigated how GA affected asthmatic behavior, leukocyte infiltration, histopathological alterations, oxidative stress, immunoglobulin E (IgE) production, and airway inflammation. ELISA and immunohistochemistry (IHC) techniques were employed to measure Nrf2, HO-1, and NF-kappaB's expression. To investigate the protein-ligand interaction between GA and Keap1, molecular docking analysis was utilized. The GA treatment significantly reduced nasal scratching, oxidative stress in the lungs, the infiltration of inflammatory cells, IgE content, iron accumulation, and NF-kappaB activation. It also upregulated Nrf2 and HO-1. Additionally, in silico studies revealed GA and Keap1 binding to activate Nrf2 by disrupting the Keap1-Nrf2 interaction. The study at hand is the first to investigate and report on the immunomodulatory impacts of GA on induced asthma in BALB/c mice. Our findings reveal that GA can be utilized as an anti-asthmatic agent via Nrf2/HO-1 and NF-kappaB pathway regulation.
abstract_zh: 哮喘是一种导致呼吸功能受损的肺部疾病，其特征是炎症细胞的明显浸润。龙胆酸（GA）是一种常见于食品成分中的酚酸，具有抗氧化、抗菌和抗炎特性。然而，其在缓解哮喘方面的潜在应用尚未被探索。本研究探讨了GA对过敏性哮喘的治疗潜力。通过使BALB/c小鼠致敏并激发卵清蛋白（OVA）来建立动物模型。我们研究了GA如何影响哮喘行为、白细胞浸润、组织病理学改变、氧化应激、免疫球蛋白E（IgE）产生以及气道炎症。采用ELISA和免疫组织化学（IHC）技术测量Nrf2、HO-1和NF-kappaB的表达。利用分子对接分析研究GA与Keap1之间的蛋白质-配体相互作用。GA治疗显著减少了鼻部抓挠、肺部氧化应激、炎症细胞浸润、IgE含量、铁积累和NF-kappaB激活，同时上调了Nrf2和HO-1。此外，计算机模拟研究显示，GA与Keap1结合，通过破坏Keap1-Nrf2相互作用来激活Nrf2。本研究是首次探讨并报告GA对BALB/c小鼠诱导哮喘的免疫调节作用。我们的发现表明，GA可通过调节Nrf2/HO-1和NF-kappaB通路作为抗哮喘药物使用。
